newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MCCONNELL D GROUP WINS A$83 MLN SAUDI JOB.
newsitem.headline: MCCONNELL D GROUP WINS A$83 MLN SAUDI JOB.

text.p: Building contractor McConnell Dowell Corp Ltd said on Monday the McConnell Dowell-Petrocon Consortium had been awarded an A$83 million oil refinery upgrade contract in Saudi Arabia.
The contract, awarded by Saudi Aramco, is for the engineering design, procurement and construction of an upgrade of Aramco's Riyadh refinery.
Petrocon is a U.S.-based engineering company.
Under the deal, McConnell Dowell is to complete all field construction work. Construction proper is expected to commence in February/March 1998, it said.
McConnell Dowell said other contracts recently won totalled over A$40 million with good forward prospects in all its major markets.
McConnell Dowell is about 63 percent owned by Montreal-based Dominion Bridge Corp.
